name: ACDi Manufacturing Plant – Branford, CT
old_description: We believe you deserve a true collaborator that will work with you through each phase of your project. Since 1984, we’ve helped clients get over 11,000 projects from idea to reality.
about:
ACDi Manufacturing Plant operates from Branford, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1984. The company began as an electronics manufacturing services provider and has since grown to support over 11,000 projects across its history.

The facility provides a full range of printed circuit board assembly and systems manufacturing services. Core processes include surface mount technology (SMT) and through-hole assembly, both leaded and lead-free, as well as box builds, electromechanical assembly, chassis and rack-level integration, press-fit and custom mechanical assemblies, and automated cable production. Additional capabilities encompass conformal coating, protective finishes, testing and inspection, compliance and life-cycle services, obsolescence mitigation, materials procurement, and customized kitting and packaging. The company also offers new product introduction (NPI) support and prototype-to-production scaling, with PCB layout services available through a partner.

ACDi primarily serves the aerospace and defense sector, holding AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certifications and maintaining ITAR registration for sensitive government work. Its customer base includes organizations requiring stringent quality and regulatory compliance for electronic assemblies and systems.

The company positions itself as a collaborative partner that manages projects from concept through completion, emphasizing an "Honor the Schedule" pledge to meet agreed timelines and an end-to-end in-house approach designed to reduce vendor coordination risks.
